finding: A single Admin.addColumnFamily whose master response is delayed past the client RPC timeout (after ModifyTableProcedure already added the family) is retried by RpcRetryingCaller; the retry hits the 'already exists' check in HMaster.addColumn and the client gets InvalidFamilyOperationException although the family was added by that same call.
same_root_cause: Yes. The buggy HBaseAdmin.addColumnFamilyAsync builds the request inside rpcCall() with ng.newNonce() (hbase-client/.../HBaseAdmin.java:1027), so every retry attempt carries a fresh nonce, and HMaster.addColumn (HMaster.java:2253-2256) evaluates old.hasColumnFamily() before and outside NonceProcedureRunnable's nonce dedup. The retry therefore cannot be recognised as a duplicate and is rejected. The fix hunks change exactly this: HBaseAdmin hoists 'Long nonceGroup = ng.getNonceGroup(); Long nonce = ng.newNonce();' out of rpcCall() so retries reuse the nonce, and HMaster.addColumn moves the hasColumnFamily check into a TableDescriptorGetter evaluated inside the NonceProcedureRunnable.run() of the new private modifyTable(), so a retried request with the same nonce is deduplicated before the check runs.
realistic: Yes. Mini cluster, default client retry policy with a valid hbase.rpc.timeout (3s); the only injection is a master coprocessor whose postModifyTable sleeps ~6s after the procedure completed, i.e. a delay in the master RPC handler that makes the response arrive after the client timeout, which a GC pause, overloaded master or slow network can produce. The client's retry is its own normal RpcRetryingCaller behaviour; no reflection, fabricated arguments or direct calls to the check.
fixed_version: On the buggy tree plus the fix's production changes the test fails at its fail("expected the retried addColumn to be rejected") line in both runs: addColumnFamily now returns successfully, no InvalidFamilyOperationException is thrown. The retry reuses the nonce and is deduplicated, so the consequence is gone.
reason: The agent's failing execution is exactly HBASE-20642: a client-retried addColumn DDL with a new nonce is not recognised by the master as a retry of an already-applied operation and is rejected with InvalidFamilyOperationException. The trigger (RPC timeout from a delayed master response) is realistic and the consequence (a successful add reported as failed) matches the JIRA. The fixed version makes the call succeed, which supports this.
